name: StoreasyUpload
description: Upload an IPA, AAB, APK or MSIX to storeasy, which checks it and delivers it to a store test channel. Workload identity (OIDC) or a CI token.
helpMarkDown: Uploads a build to storeasy build intake. Identity: an Azure Resource Manager service connection with workload identity federation (OIDC, matched by a storeasy trusted publisher rule) or a storeasy CI token from a secret variable.
author: storeasy

inputs.name: connectedService
inputs.label: Service connection (workload identity)
inputs.helpMarkDown: A service connection that uses workload identity federation. Its OIDC token (subject sc://organization/project/connection) is exchanged for a 15 minute storeasy upload token. Add the matching trusted publisher rule in storeasy > Intake. Leave empty to use a CI token.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.label: storeasy app id
inputs.helpMarkDown: The app's id in storeasy (the number in the app's URL).

inputs.name: file
inputs.label: Package
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path of the IPA, AAB, APK or MSIX to upload.

inputs.name: url
inputs.label: storeasy URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL; change it for a self-hosted storeasy.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: CI token
inputs.helpMarkDown: A storeasy CI token (sci_...) from a secret variable, for example $(STOREASY_TOKEN). Used when no service connection is set. Never paste the value here.

inputs.name: store
inputs.label: Store
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional; storeasy checks it against the package.

inputs.name: track
inputs.label: Play test track
inputs.helpMarkDown: internal, alpha, beta or a closed track. Overrides the app's delivery rule for this upload.

inputs.name: group
inputs.label: TestFlight internal group
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overrides the app's delivery rule for this upload.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.label: Release notes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Release notes or What to Test.

inputs.name: wait
inputs.label: Wait for the delivery
inputs.helpMarkDown: Follow the delivery and fail the task if the package is rejected or the store refuses it.

outputVariables.name: StoreasyDuplicate
outputVariables.description: true when storeasy already had this exact file.

outputVariables.name: StoreasyExitCode
outputVariables.description: 0 delivered or duplicate, 2 rejected, 3 identity, 4 store error, 5 wait timed out.

outputVariables.name: StoreasySessionUrl
outputVariables.description: Link to the session in storeasy.
